title: Beethoven's bone conduction

tellings.quote: he was deaf and he used something called bone conduction

plain: The composer Ludwig van Beethoven went deaf in Vienna in the early 1800s, and he kept hearing music through bone conduction, sound carried through the bones of the skull rather than the ears. Michels mentions it himself, without naming a source, in an episode about a CIA scientist who says he contacted an alien council. He uses it as an example of sound or signals reaching a person without passing through the usual senses.
